capabilities.untrusted: Detection reads the build files and the tab shows; dev mode does not start in an untrusted workspace.
config.enabled: Off: the Quarkus satellite registers nothing.
config.devPort: Dev mode's HTTP port. `0`: `%dev.quarkus.http.port`, then `quarkus.http.port` from `application.properties`, then `8080`.
config.debugPort: Dev mode's `-Ddebug=<port>` when a run asks for the debugger. Without it dev mode runs with `-Ddebug=false`, so no JDWP port is open.
config.readiness: The path dev mode's readiness probe GETs. Empty: the log line `Listening on:` instead (a project without `quarkus-smallrye-health`).
config.devMemoryMiB: The cap dev mode declares to the core's managed process — Maven plus the application JVM it forks — summed against `#batlehub.java.resources.budgetMiB#` before it starts.
config.bridge: `auto`: write `microprofile.tools.server.java.home` (workspace scope, through the manifest) only when the MicroProfile language server has no JDK 17 or newer. `never`: do not.
